text:
anya: kicking off a soft bring-up for v3.2-int4-ensemble (ensemble = v3.2-pt + v3.2-int4 stacked)
maria: nice — what's the rollout plan? shadow first or tiny live? :eyes:
anya: shadow 5% for 2h across uniform traffic, then 0.5% live on long-doc slices if shadow looks clean
jon: do we have an automated gate or manual check after shadow? i'd prefer auto fallback if metrics break
anya: plan is automated consensus gate: we require 3/4 metrics to be within delta thresholds AND no slice > slice_threshold
leo: outline the metrics please
anya: metrics = [ROUGE-L_delta, halluc_rate_delta, latency_p95_delta, topk_dist_delta]
maria: what are deltas?
anya: baseline = v3.1-pt. thresholds:
- ROUGE-L: >= -0.02 (allow small drop)
- halluc_rate: <= +0.015 (no big hallucination jump)
- latency_p95: <= +0.08 (relative)
- topk_dist: <= +0.03
jon: and slice_threshold?
anya: single slice > 0.05 on halluc or rouge triggers immediate rollback
ops-sre: heads-up: ops will enforce p95_latency hard cap of +0.15; if that hits we auto-cut traffic
eval-bot: shadow run complete (2h)
eval-bot: SUMMARY: overall ROUGE-L -0.009, halluc +0.012, latency_p95 +0.06, topk_dist +0.018
maria: looks within thresholds, but any outlier slices?
eval-bot: SLICES: longcode_docs halluc +0.032 (50 samples), legal_contracts rouge -0.045 (30 samples)
jon: longcode_docs > slice_threshold — that's a red flag
anya: agreed. will not promote live. starting a bisect on ensemble weighting to isolate which model is causing longcode regression
leo: can you drop a config snippet of the ensemble you're testing?
anya: sure

```
ensemble:
  name: v3.2-int4-ensemble
  members:
    - id: v3.2-pt
      weight: 0.6
    - id: v3.2-int4
      weight: 0.4
routing:
  slices: [longcode_docs, longform, short]
  default_fraction: 0.005
canary:
  window_mins: 30
  gating: consensus(3_of_4)
  slice_abort_threshold: 0.05
```

maria: try lowering int4 weight to 0.2 for the shadow and re-run against longcode slice
anya: will do

eval-bot: re-run (weights 0.7/0.3) finished
eval-bot: SUMMARY: longcode_docs halluc +0.010, overall ROUGE-L -0.004, latency_p95 +0.055
jon: much better. so int4 was contributing to hallucination on that slice
anya: proposal: allow staged live ramp but with hysteresis: need 3 consecutive windows (30m) within consensus to increment traffic; single fail decrements by half
leo: add an adaptive fallback that reduces weight of int4 on failing slices automatically rather than full cut
maria: how does that interact with canary visibility in console? need clear events
anya: rollout events will include: canary_start, slice_event (slice_name, delta, action), auto_weight_adjust, promote_step
ops-sre: also ensure we emit alert if `promote_step` gets stuck > 2h without reaching target
jon: what about A/B comparison telemetry? we should compute uplift CI and a tie-breaker metric for safety
anya: using uplift CI on ROUGE-L and a safety penalty = halluc_rate * 10. The final score = ROUGE-L_uplift - safety_penalty
maria: makes sense. set automatic fallback when final_score < -0.03 OR any slice penalty > 0.05
anya: agreed. i'll push the canary config to staging and schedule a 1h manual observation window after first auto-promote
leo: small nit — expose per-variant kv-cache warmup time as a metric, we saw coldstart penalties earlier
anya: good call. adding kv_warmup_sec to the gate vector

jon: next steps?
anya: 1) push ensemble weights 0.7/0.3 to shadow (done)
2) run 2h shadow (done)
3) if shadow clean then enable live 0.5% for longform slices only
4) auto-hysteresis with 3 windows to ramp

maria: thumbs up from me if no new slices pop
ops-sre: monitoring hooks in place, alert thresholds set
anya: thanks team. i'll post results in ~3h
leo: :thumbsup:
jon: :rocket:
